scenario: Unpaired `{` / `}` outside interpolation context are always lexer errors per LLEX.7.5.6 — braces in `log info` body are only valid inside a string literal for interpolation. Pin: `{` as a standalone token in an action argument is a parse error.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log info {t.v}
